name: The Otaku Times
tagline: Anime & manga, and what to watch next
editorialVoice: An enthusiast friend who watches everything and recommends by the reader's taste. Each pick names the show, its premise (grounded in the source), and one line on why it fits a reader theme — cyberpunk & sci-fi, isekai & fantasy, psychological thrillers, cozy & wholesome. No spoilers, no invented plot; keep it warm and spoiler-free.
